subject: Temporary tolerance window request for P1/P2 response during migration
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmeops.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: temporary response-time tolerance during data migration

Hi Rohan,

Heads up — AcmeOps is planning a cross-region data migration the weekend of Aug 20–21. Our infra team expects a coordinated DB lock and DNS cutover; we anticipate an elevated risk window where automated retries and some API paths may show transient errors.

We rely on Redwood's P1/P2 response commitments as part of our SLA. Given the migration activity, we need to request a short, documented tolerance to the response windows for the migration window only: the ask is P1 allowance up to 60 minutes and P2 allowance up to 4 hours between 2026-08-20 00:00 UTC and 2026-08-20 08:00 UTC.

Please confirm whether Redwood can sign off on this temporary tolerance, and outline the fallback/escalation contacts if we see incidents. We also need any contract amendment or DocuSign so our procurement team can log the change.

Thanks —
Tom Ellis
Head of SRE, AcmeOps

--
AcmeOps (on-call: +1-617-555-0199)
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmeops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: temporary response-time tolerance during data migration

Tom — thanks for the heads up and detailed window. I can own coordinating this from our side.

Proposal (initial):
- Window: 2026-08-20 00:00 UTC to 2026-08-20 08:00 UTC.
- Temporary SLA tolerance: P1 -> 60 minutes; P2 -> 4 hours for the window only.
- Requirements: AcmeOps will run the migration plan and confirm start/end times in-channel; Redwood to enable elevated monitoring, keep on-call staffed, and maintain an incident bridge if a P1 occurs.

Looping in Marissa (operational approval) and Ben (commercial/procurement) to confirm runway and any credit/contract steps. I am attaching the migration-maintenance-runbook.pdf that we reviewed internally; it contains the proposed on-call staffing and rollback triggers.

If you can reply with the procurement contact (if different than procurement@acmeops.com) and a go/no-go by EOD tomorrow, we will finalize the exception doc and provide a DocuSign link.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T13:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: temporary response-time tolerance during data migration

Thanks for pulling this together, Rohan. I reviewed the runbook and the attached SLA impact analysis. Approve in principle with the following conditions: 

1) Monitoring & thresholds: Engineering must enable the migration-specific dashboards and set automated paging for the first sustained error burst > 5% request error rate for 5 consecutive minutes.
2) Rollback triggers: If any of the three critical endpoints (auth, generate, embeddings) exceed 10% error or if latency degrades beyond the predicted baseline by >250% for 10 minutes, autoscale and rollback steps must execute.
3) Staffing: On-call staffing confirmed — primary on-call is listed in the runbook; Laura Bennett will be the escalation lead for Redwood engineering during the window. Laura, confirm you have coverage.
4) Postmortem & credits: We require a joint post-migration incidence review within 5 business days. Any failure to meet the agreed rollback/monitoring plan that causes customer-visible downtime will follow the standard SLA credit schedule; Ben, please prepare an amendment template for procurement.

Once Ben has the commercial language and Rohan confirms the final window, I will sign and send the approval packet (approved_exception_sla_amendment.pdf) for DocuSign.

-Marissa
VP, Operations
Redwood Inference

--

All — quick commercial note. We can accommodate the short SLA tolerance as a one-off exception for the stated window. Proposed commercial steps:
- Prepare a one-page amendment that documents the temporary tolerance and the exact timestamp window.
- No automatic credits will be given if the migration proceeds under the agreed runbook and rollback triggers; credits apply only if the rollback plan fails and customer-visible downtime occurs per the SLA.
- For procurement: Natalie, please confirm billing contact or PO needs; procurement@acmeops.com is included here.

I will draft the amendment language (simple, limited-scope, EOD Aug 16) and attach for Marissa to sign.

-Ben
